name: Duplicate Sales Order Check
query:
SELECT
    amazon_order_id,
    grand_total,
    company,
    GROUP_CONCAT(name ORDER BY creation SEPARATOR ', ') AS sales_orders,
    COUNT(*) AS total_count
FROM
    `tabSales Order`
WHERE
    amazon_order_id IS NOT NULL
    AND amazon_order_id != ''
GROUP BY
    amazon_order_id,
    grand_total,
    company
HAVING
    COUNT(*) > 1;
